Fields.Name: Forward
Fields.Description: Vector indicating the dummy point's forward direction.

Fields.Name: Upward
Fields.Description: Vector indicating the dummy point's upward direction.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of dummy point this is (hitbox, sfx, etc).

Fields.Name: Parent Bone Index
Fields.Description: Index of a bone that the dummy point is initially transformed to before binding to the attach bone.

Fields.Name: Attach Bone Index
Fields.Description: Index of the bone that the dummy point follows physically.

Fields.Name: Follow Attach Bone
Fields.Description: Whether the dummy follows the attach bone.

Fields.Name: Use Upward Vector
Fields.Description: If false, the upward vector is not read.
